description: "Ask Jev for a risk tier, a finding judgment, or a score when you are not about to approve or comment."
---

# Asking Jev

Call this extension's `evaluate` tool when you need a typed judgment over
a pull request and you are not about to approve or comment. It returns
answers only. The tool appears as `<namespace>__evaluate`.

## Questions

Pass `state` (the pull request title, a short summary of the diff, and
any draft finding) and one or more questions. Each question has an `id`,
a `type`, and `instructions`.

- `boolean`: probability of true between 0 and 1
- `choice`: `criteria` maps each option name to a short description; the
  answer names one option
- `score`: `criteria` from lowest to highest; the answer is a number
  along that rubric

`instructions` can set the decision, who the review is for, and which
evidence to weigh. Pass the pull request summary, not the checkout.

## Reading answers

A boolean answer has `probability`. A choice has `choice` and
`probabilities`. A score has `score` and `probabilities`.

When an approval or a review comment must follow the judgment, use a
project tool that calls `decide` itself. Do not treat these answers as
a GitHub write.
